reason: ₹4,999 before I've seen it work, and then ₹999 every month forever, is too much for a 3-chair parlour. My register and my own count of the drawer every night cost me nothing.
objection: A monthly bill that never stops, and when the app hangs on a busy Sunday with customers waiting, who do I call? I am not paying every month for something that leaves me stuck.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, or setup only paid after the free month once I see the cash-drawer check actually matches my count, plus a local number someone picks up on Sundays.
